## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Joy Events & Catering?
No 8, Church Street, Bharat Nagar Extension, Menambedu, Ambattur, Chennai 600 053.

### What facilities does Joy Events & Catering have?
Wedding catering, Reception catering, Christian wedding catering, Brahmin / pure-veg catering, Ambur & Chennai biryani, Chettinad & regional, North Indian & tandoor, Live counters, Corporate catering, Birthday parties, Housewarming, Seemantham, Stage & floral décor, Mobile kitchen units.

### How many guests can you cater for?
From 25 to 5,000 guests.

### Do you offer a price lock?
Yes. Confirm your date at least six months in advance and the per-guest price quoted today is the price you pay on the day.

### How do I check if Joy Events & Catering is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 82204 44034.
